verdict.rationale: An HR/payroll platform could plausibly let users send one document to many employees for signature, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about bulk-sending a document to multiple recipients. The only document-related item is a webhook event catalog listing 'signatory, document' events, which is an adjacent notification mechanism, not a bulk-send capability.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can bulk-send the same document to many recipients at once
